notes:
- DT effects now install as DAW plug-ins only (VST3 on Windows, VST3 + AU on macOS) — load them inside your DAW like any other stock effect. No more standalone desktop apps.
- Windows: the full set of all 21 effects now installs (previously only a handful) into the system VST3 folder so Ableton Live & co. discover them.
- Distortion & Clipper: "Match Loudness" now turns the real Output dial down/up as you drive harder, so perceived level stays steady; warmer, cleaner analog-style saturation with a DC blocker. Clipper Ceiling↔Output link is on by default.
- Delay: louder and more Ableton-like — full-level first repeat and an equal-power dry/wet mix so the dry signal doesn't dip.
- Multiband Exciter: click anywhere in a band to bypass its saturation (band still passes); cleaner high-band tone and stronger, more usable drive range.
- Auto Filter: resonance now bottoms out at a true zero (no resonance) and defaults there.
- Factory presets added across the stock effects.
- Each plug-in checks for updates when it opens and shows an in-DAW banner when a new DT version is available.
